title: Lisova pack
description: This texture pack add real texture from real life to minecraft
body:
Ever wondered what it would be like to see the blocky world of Minecraft like in real life? Lisova pack transforms your game by replacing the default textures with high-resolution photographs of real-world materials and objects.

Forget stylized art—this pack aims for maximum realism. Dirt isn't just drawn brown; it's a high-definition photograph of real soil. Stone walls are made from actual photographed rock faces, and wood planks come from scanned timber. Every block is designed to make your world feel tangible and grounded in reality.

✨ Features:

· Photorealistic Textures: Every block texture is sourced from real-life photographs (stone, wood, ores, gravel, etc.).
· Immersive Experience: Perfect for builders who want a gritty, realistic feel or players using shaders to enhance lighting and shadows.
· High Definition: Crisp, clear textures that hold up well even in 4K resolution (Resolution may vary by block).
· Vanilla Feel: While the look changes, the block identity stays the same. You'll never question what a block is supposed to be.
